method: read-only digest of docs/recon/*.md; every point carries its source line
grade_policy: external reference only; never our L1-L4 grade

docs.title: FM27: where the game keeps bans

key_points.point: Mac Steam build, July 2026 save; found via RTTI class names (db::ACTUAL_PLAYER, BAN_SCOPE).
Absences live in the medical record's second list at +0x18 (32-byte entries), not a separate object.
Absence entry: +0x00 u32 id + reach/kind bytes, +0x10 start date, +0x14 u16 discipline rule, +0x16 u16 0xFFFF = ban, +0x1C u8 matches left.
652 players had absences; 24 entries were bans of 23 players; discipline rule 65 = European club competitions, 72 = South American.
Lifting a ban removes the entry from the list but leaves the block in memory; undo re-lists it.
Windows Steam 26227640 reads the same offsets (17 banned players) - the ban layout did not move between platforms.

docs.title: FM27: a club's debts

key_points.point: Club -> info record at +0x100; the info record holds a (begin,end,capacity) pointer list at +0x50.
Each debt is 0x1C bytes: +0x00 original, +0x04 payable/month, +0x08 interest, +0x10 end date, +0x14 start date, +0x18 type, +0x19 always 1.
Type codes 1..15 named from the game's own English strings (Bank Loan, State Loan, PIK Loan, Misc. Debt ...).
Debt amounts add up to the screen's figures; PIK loans (type 13) mean something else for both payment words.
Open: +0x1A's 0x8000 value and the exact screen arithmetic for PIK.

docs.title: FM27: contract clauses, squad statuses and kinds of contract

key_points.point: Contract clause list at +0x68 holds 8-byte entries: u32 amount (0xFFFFFFFF none), u16 condition (0xFFFF none), u16 kind.
56 clause kinds tabulated with in-game names (release clauses, wage rises/drops, bonuses, extensions).
Squad status is a byte at +0x54 with its own code table.
Kind of contract at +0xC3 (full/loan/youth etc.).
Loyalty bonus at +0x38 and +0xA8.
Mac offsets noted separately - same layout, own field base.

docs.title: FM27: loans

key_points.point: A loan is a separate db::LOAN_CONTRACT reached via player+0x338 -> record+0x00 (own contract stays at +0x330).
Loan contract is laid out as a contract up to the squad number: +0x08 owner, +0x10/+0x18 team, +0x20 wage, +0x44 from, +0x48 until, +0x54 status, +0x5D number.
The 32-byte record holds up to four contract pointers: +0x00 loan, +0x08 B-team, +0x10 basic/full, +0x18 another B-team.
3,596 of 5,637 players with the record were on loan; 2,041 had the record without a loan.
Recalling sets the record to null and restores team+0x130, leaving +0x138 at the loan club.

docs.title: FM27: people's names
sections: ## How the game makes a name

key_points.point: Player name ids at +0x2D8/+0x2E0/+0x2E8 (first/last/common), full name FM string at +0x2C8; staff mirror at +0x150/+0x158/+0x160/+0x140.
An FM string is u32 length + UTF-8 text with a NUL, after a u32 holder count; strings are shared.
Three tables (first/last/common), 24-byte entries: +0x00 text pointer, +0x08 u32 id, +0x0C u16 nation index, +0x0E u16 weight, +0x12 flags, +0x13 ethnicity-ish.
Each table is reached both as a list-by-id (static before the players pair) and as the database's per-nation list.
The entries are slots of one object pool of 24-byte slots.

docs.title: FM27: nations and their national teams
sections: ## What a tab could take from this

key_points.point: A national team is NOT a club: the clubs array holds none; each nation has men's and women's db::NATIONAL_TEAM_CONTAINER.
251 db::NATION objects, 0x208 bytes each: +0x0C UID, +0x18 name, +0x28 3-letter code, +0xF0 capital, +0xF8 continent, +0x100 region, +0x108 currency, +0x110/+0x118 containers, +0x1EC population.
502 containers of 0x8A0 bytes; two arrays of 251 next to the players'/staff's/clubs' arrays.
National teams are laid out like a club's [team], so a club team view reads them.
Editor worklist and youth-team notes.

docs.title: FM27: secondary nationalities and homegrown status

key_points.point: All non-primary nationalities live in one relations list: player+0x2C0 (macOS; +0x300 on Windows) -> (begin,end,capacity) of 16-byte entries.
Entry: +0x00 target pointer, +0x0A target kind (1 club, 3 person, 7 competition, 8 nation), +0x0B relation kind, +0x0C value, +0x0F always 0xFF.
Relation 9 nation value 100/80 = secondary nationality; 70 = trained in nation; 72 = trained at club; 109 = no work permit needed.
Room: the list is a fixed-capacity vector; growing it moves it.
Checked in game: eligibility page matches relation 70/72.

docs.title: FM27: the game's pools of objects, and signing a free agent

key_points.point: Pool statics: +0x00 chunk pointer list, +0x18 first free slot, +0x20 free/used counts, +0x28 slot bytes + first-chunk slots, +0x30 later-chunk slots + 100.
Scan of writable data found 279 pools; free-slot chains validated in all of them.
Contracts pool at game_plugin+0x5672020 (0.9.2409.0); 12,824 used slots matching 12,824 db::FULL_CONTRACT objects.
Signing a free agent means allocating a contract object in the pool, since no free-agent list exists.

docs.title: FM27: where the game keeps prize money

key_points.point: sicomps::LEAGUE_STAGE +0xF0 -> settings; FUTURE_STAGE +0x90 -> settings it will use.
LEAGUE_SETTINGS 0x2F0 apart: +0x148 per win, +0x150 per draw, +0x154 per loss, +0x1E0 list of pounds by final position.
db::COMP +0x0C UID (again at +0x10), +0x40 name, +0x48 short name.
Amounts come from the database and repeat across saves/seasons; some leagues have no per-position list.
Knockout round money is not in these settings.

docs.title: A club's sponsorship deals
sections: ## What the game does with them

key_points.point: Club+0x130 -> (begin,end,capacity) of pointers; each deal is 24 bytes.
Deal: +0x00/+0x04 dates, +0x08 total, +0x0C per season, +0x10 relegation %, +0x12 reputation at signing, +0x14 kind.
Kind codes 1..23 named from the game's Sponsorship screen.
Season money is the sum of per-season amounts, booked once at season start.

docs.title: FM27: staff jobs, where clubs keep their staff, and staff contracts
sections: ## Where a club keeps its staff
## Signing a member of staff with no club

key_points.point: Job code is a u8 at contract+0x26; a player-coach's is his coaching job + 1.
Job code table cross-checked against the game's own language files (example.ltf / languages.fmf zstd frames).
A club keeps staff in department lists: medical +0x60, coaching +0x78, scouting +0x90; directors of football at club+0x148.
A team points at its manager's object at team+0x80 (null for none).
Staff contracts: wage/start/end/status/kind in the same contract object family.

docs.title: FM27 on macOS: the Steam build 26227640
sections: ## Why macOS keeps the editor out
## The features first mapped on Windows
## The game's own object and its count of saves loaded
## Who a reason to be unhappy is about
## How the game words a reason to be unhappy

key_points.point: Mac app is a Unity 6000.3.18f1 universal player; game_plugin is a Mach-O bundle; LC_UUID identifies the build per arch.
Hardened runtime + notarization is why macOS keeps the editor out; a bridge is needed.
Mac object layout differs by C++ ABI: player's own fields 8 bytes earlier, person block first (+0x278), identity block after (+0x388).
Native arm64 run confirmed the Mac layout.

docs.title: FM27: tactics and transfer value

key_points.point: Transfer value is i32 at player+0x234 in pounds (Mac +0x22C); asking price +0x238 / +0x230 with -1 = not set.
300,000,000 means not for sale; -1 means never valued; the game shows values in euros at ~1.166 EUR/GBP.
A club's tactic block is reached from simatch::PREPARED_TACTICS_CREATOR_ARRAY +0x08 entries.
Tactic block: 11x16-byte slot records at +0x000, style tag at +0x100, 11 in-possession entries at +0x148 (0x48 each), out-of-possession at +0x468, second copy at +0x7D0.

docs.title: FM27: transfer offers, and contracts that are not in force yet
sections: ## A contract that is not in force yet

key_points.point: Every offered/agreed contract is its own db::FULL_CONTRACT or db::LOAN_CONTRACT; the player points only at his running one.
Each such contract is held by a 0x48-byte entry: +0x10 contract, +0x28 offer number, +0x3E state, +0x41 kind.
States 1 offered / 2 agreed awaiting its day / 3 lost; kinds 8 renewal, 7 free move, 2 transfer, 1 loan.
The offer object (FULL_TRANSFER_OFFER) carries the fee and the selling team.

docs.title: FM27: how the game records transfers
sections: ## Watching a transfer the game made
## Free agents, and releasing a player
## A club a human manager runs
## A transfer the game makes on a later day

key_points.point: A person's identity block holds internal person id at +0x08 and UID at +0x0C; internal ids are not array indexes.
One global transfer list of 48-byte records sorted by internal person id: +0x00 buying club, +0x08 selling club, +0x10 date, +0x18 amount, +0x1C person id, +0x20 flags.
The stored amount is NOT the fee (833,333 vs the £54M shown); flags' low nibble 0x0C = 12 months.
Free agents / releases recorded in the same list with null clubs.
A transfer the game makes on a later day: the reliable way to obtain one.

docs.title: FM27: youth intakes, the players the game makes, cities of birth

key_points.point: A byte before the gender flags (player+0x2A0 on Windows, +0x18 into the identity block) holds 0x08 for a game-made player.
Game-made UIDs start at 2,002,068,314; database players stop near 2,001,000,000, so the flag, not the UID, is authoritative.
No list of a club's intakes: intake players share their contract's joined day.
Cities of birth are reached through the person block's birth-city pointer.
